Short title extent and commencement

ORDINANCE LVII OF 1995
ORDINANCE LVII OF 1995
REVISION OF EMOLUMENTS OF PUBLIC REPRESENTATIVES ORDINANCE, 1995
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑‑(1) This
Ordinance may, be called the Revision of Emoluments of Public Representatives
Ordinance, 1995.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect from the 25th day of October,
1994.

sections.description:
Amendment of Act XXVII of 1974

ORDINANCE LVII OF 1995
ORDINANCE LVII OF 1995
REVISION OF EMOLUMENTS OF PUBLIC REPRESENTATIVES ORDINANCE, 1995
2. Amendment of Act XXVII of 1974.‑‑The following
amendments shall be made in the Members of Parliament (salaries and Allowances)
Act, 1974 (XXVII of 1974), namely:‑‑
(1) in section 3,‑‑
(a) for the words "three
thousand" the words "five thousand" shall be substituted; and
(b) in the proviso, for the
words "three thousand" the words "five thousand" shall be
substituted.
(2) in section 4, in subsection
(1),‑‑‑
(a) for the words "three
hundred" the words "four hundred" shall be substituted; and
(b) for the words "two
hundred" the words "two hundred and fifty" shall be substituted;
(3) in section 4B, for the word
"two" .the word "three" shall be substituted;
(4) in section 5,‑‑
(a) in subsection (1), in
clause (b), for the words "economy class" the words "business
class" shall be substituted; and
(b) after subsection (3), the
following new subsection shall be added, namely:‑‑
"(4) A member shall be,
entitled to travel by air in first class while travelling abroad on an official
visit.";
(5) in section 6, in clause
(b), for the words "economy class" the words "business
class" shall be substituted.
(6) in section 10, after
subsection (2), the following new subsection shall be inserted, namely:
"(2A). A member shall, in
addition to the vouchers referred to in subsection (1) or as the case may be,
amount of thirty thousand rupees in cash referred to in subsection (2), be
entitled to six business class open return air tickets from the airport nearest
to his constituency to Islamabad.";
(7) in section 11 for the words
"four thousand" the words "four thousand and six hundred shall
be substituted;
(8) in section 13, for
subsection (1) the following shall be substituted; namely: ‑‑
"(1) A Leader of the Muse
and a Leader of Opposition, other than the Prime Minister, shall be entitled to
the salaries, allowances and privileges as are admissible to a Federal Minister
under the Federal Ministers and Ministers of State (Salaries, Allowances and
Privileges) Act, 1975 (LXII of 1975).";
(9) after section 13, amended
as aforesaid, the following new section shall be inserted, namely:‑‑
"13A. Chairman of the Standing Committee.‑‑(1) A member
elected as the Chairman of a Standing Committee of a House shall in addition to
the salary, allowances and Facilities admissible as a member be entitled to:‑‑
(a) an honorarium of seven
thousand and seven hundred rupees per month;
(b) the services of a Private
Secretary in Basic Pay Scale 17, Stenographer in Basic Pay Scale 15, Driver in
Basic Pay Scale 4 and one Naib-?Qasid in Basic Pay Scale 1;
(c) telephone facility in the
office to a limit of five thousand rupees per month;
(d) office accommodation with
necessary furniture and equipment;
(e) a 1300 CC car and 360
litres of petrol per month for local use; and
(f) installation of telephone
at the residence at Islamabad at Government expense and exemption of rental and
payment of charges of calls up to a maximum of two thousand five hundred rupees
per month:
Provided that the Chairman of
the Standing Committee of a House, shall, on the provision of car under clause
(e), not be entitled to conveyance allowance referred to in section 4.";
and
Explanation.‑‑For
the purpose of this section, the Functional Committees of the Senate, namely,
the Committee on Government Assurances, Committee on Problems of Less Developed
Areas, Committees on Human Rights and Committee on Rules of Procedure and
Privileges shall deemed to be the Standing Committees thereof. "; and
(10) after section 14A, the
following new section shall be inserted, namely:‑‑
"14‑B. Increase in
emoluments.‑‑The salaries, allowances and privileges of Members
shall automatically be revised alongwith the revision of the emoluments of the
civil servants.".

ORDINANCE LVII OF 1995
ORDINANCE LVII OF 1995
REVISION OF EMOLUMENTS OF PUBLIC REPRESENTATIVES ORDINANCE, 1995
7. Amendment of Act LXXXI(1 of 1975.‑‑The following
amendments shall be made in the Chairman and Speaker (Salaries, Allowances and
Privileges) Act, 1975 (LXXXII of 1975), namely:‑‑
(1) in section 2,. in clause
(c), for the words "wife or wives" the word "spouse" shall be substituted; .
(2) in section 3, for the words
"seven thousand" the words "twenty thousand two hundred and fifty" shall be, substituted;.
(3) in section 4, for the words
"four thousand" the words "five thousand" shall be
substituted;
(4) in section 6, for the words
"three thousand" the words "six thousand." shall be
substituted;
(5) in section 7, after the
word "Speaker", the words "and the members of their
families" shall be inserted;
(6) in section 8,‑‑
(a) in subsection (1), in the
proviso, for the words "one thousand" the words "three
thousand" shall be substituted;
(b) in subsection (IA), for the
words "eight thousand" the words "seventeen thousand" shall
be substituted;
(c) in subsection (2), for the
words "sixty thousand" the words "one hundred thousand"
shall be substituted;
(d) in subsection (3), for the
words "eight thousand" the words "seventeen thousand" shall
be substituted; and
(e) in subsection (4), for the
words "eight thousand" the words "seventeen thousand" shall
be substituted;
(7) after section 8, amended as
aforesaid, the following new section shall be inserted, namely:‑‑
"8A. Residential telephone, etc.‑‑(1) The Chairman or the
Speaker shall be entitled to a telephone to be installed at his residence at
Government expense and shall be exempted from payment of its rental and charges
of calls made therefrom within the country.
(2) A casual telephone facility
shall be provided to the Chairman or the Speaker during his tour within the
country.".
(8) in section 10, in
subsection (1), for the word "fifty" the words "four
,,hundred" shall be substituted;
(9) in section 16, in
subsection (1) for the words "one lakh and fifty thousand" the words
"three hundred thousand" shall be substituted;
(10) in section 17, in
subsection (2), for the words "seven thousand" the words "twenty
thousand two hundred and fifty" shall be substituted; and
(11) after section 17, amended
as aforesaid, the following new section shall be inserted, namely:‑‑
"17A. Discretionary grant.‑‑The Chairman and the Speaker
shall be authorised to a discretionary grant of six hundred thousand rupees per
annum."; and
(12) after section 19, the
following new section shall be inserted; namely:‑‑ .
"19A. Increase in emoluments. ‑‑‑The salaries,
allowances and privileges of Chairman and Speaker shall automatically be
revised alongwith the revision of the emoluments of the civil servants.".
